metadata.title: Difference in `torch.normal` between pytorch 1.8.1 and pytorch 1.9.0

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



I observed the following difference in `torch.normal` and not sure is it intentional or not.

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling torch.normal with empty tensors whose dimensions require broadcasting, especially when one or more dimensions are zero, causing incorrect shape handling or runtime failure.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.normal with zero-sized mean and std tensors whose shapes require broadcasting, e.g. mean shape (0, 2) and std shape (0, 1).

failure_behavior.description: Calling torch.normal with zero-sized mean and std tensors whose shapes require broadcasting, e.g. mean shape (0, 2) and std shape (0, 1).
